status.structure_analysis: VERIFIED from config, safetensors index and headers without loading source weight payload; 30 text layers, 128 routed experts/top-8, 25 sliding-attention + 5 full-attention layers.
status.mxfp8_model_free_static_fp8_kv: VERIFIED 2026-09-28 with AutoRound 0.16.0.dev193; AutoRound export recorded static 8-bit float KV scheme and vLLM quantized eval loaded successfully using FP8 KV.
status.evaluation: VERIFIED full PIQA/MMLU/HellaSwag/GSM8K eval at max_model_len=131072 and kv_cache_dtype=fp8; gate GO with max_accuracy_drop=0.02.

environment.gpu: 3x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, physical GPUs 1,2,3 for the validated run
environment.required_env: AR_DISABLE_META_LOAD=1 for static-kv scale materialization in the fused-MoE Transformers 5 meta-load path

source_checkpoint_count.count_note: Keep the nominal total_params_B figure separate from unique serialized tensor elements; use this index-derived count for stored-weight dtype and size audits.

text_tower.attention_projections: q/k/o in all 30 layers; v_proj in the 25 sliding-attention layers; the 5 full-attention source layers have no v_proj

precision_allocation.count_note: Derived from total F8_E4M3 weight elements minus routed-expert weight elements; covers q/k/o in all layers and v in the 25 sliding-attention layers.

quantized_export.vision_layer_kv_scales: 54 zero values from text-only calibration; vision is BF16 and excluded from language_model_only evaluation

ignore_layers_rationale: Protect routing, vision tower/projection, token embeddings, and the always-on shared mlp branch. AutoRound reports embed_tokens does not match a supported quantizable module because embeddings are not Linear targets; the key remains BF16. The checkpoint has no multi_modal_projector key; do not add that unmatched pattern.

model_free_rtn_static_fp8_kv.runner: AQA run YAML; do not execute a hand-built AutoRound command for the run
model_free_rtn_static_fp8_kv.expected_size: about 29-30 GB; validated export 28.412 GB (26.46 GiB), about 1.82x smaller than BF16 source

results.gate: GO; max_accuracy_drop=0.02; all four paired scores are non-decreasing

model_free_rtn_static_fp8_kv.evaluation: vLLM 0.29.0, kv_cache_dtype=fp8, max_model_len=131072, TP=1/PP=3; PIQA/MMLU/HellaSwag/GSM8K from repository recipes; GSM8K chat template disabled because the tokenizer has no chat_template
model_free_rtn_static_fp8_kv.limitations: The benchmark prompts are not a 128K stress test; vision, thinking-on, agentic, throughput, and latency were not evaluated.

static_kv_scale_meta_materialization.symptom: AutoRound failed to materialize newly created self_attn.k_scale and self_attn.v_scale parameters from the checkpoint while using the fused-MoE meta skeleton.
static_kv_scale_meta_materialization.root_cause: The BF16 source checkpoint has no static KV scale tensors; the meta materializer expected the new parameters to exist in the source checkpoint.
static_kv_scale_meta_materialization.fix: Set AR_DISABLE_META_LOAD=1 so Transformers loads the model on CPU and initializes the new parameters normally. Retain the AQA YAML and monitor host RAM; validated peak RAM was about 64.14 GiB.

gsm8k_missing_chat_template.symptom: lm_eval failed to build GSM8K requests because the official/local tokenizer config has no chat_template.
gsm8k_missing_chat_template.fix: Set apply_chat_template=false and fewshot_as_multiturn=false for this model; preserve the repository GSM8K recipe, 5-shot, seed and generation budget.

verification.pre_run: aqa validate <fresh-run.yaml>; aqa run <fresh-run.yaml> --dry-run; inspect selected physical GPUs before execution
verification.post_export: Check quantized/ model.safetensors.index.json and safetensors headers; compare output size with the 51.612 GB BF16 source; verify quantization_config.json kv_cache_scheme and nonzero text-layer k/v scales
